feeds.title: Summerhill Dairy Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog to know more about Summerhill Goat Dairy and what are the benefits of switching to goat milk. Summerhill Goat Dairy has been family-owned and operated for more than 20 years. Our goats live only a short walk from our state of the art milking parlour and creamery. They produce milk and we pasteurize and bottle it.

feeds.title: Kentucky Sheep And Goat Blog
feeds.description: Visit our blog to keep up with the latest sheep and goat events and updates in Kentucky. The Kentucky Sheep and Goat Development Office provides professional support to all aspects of the Commonwealth's sheep and goat industries and its goal is to maintain Kentucky's leadership in the production and marketing of small ruminants.

feeds.title: Gretta's Goats Blog
feeds.description: Our blog tells you everything going on with Gretta's Goats, including new animal additions, collaboration, cheese recipes, and more. Gretta's Goats is currently offering a wide variety of seasonal farmstead goat milk cheeses, goat milk soaps, raw honey and pasture raised chicken eggs. Our goats and chickens rotationally graze on organically managed pastures.

feeds.title: The Dirty Old Goat Soap Co. Blog
feeds.description: Get all the information you need about handmade goat's milk soaps. When my goat Myrtle began producing more milk than I could consume, I found the idea of making goat's milk soap which was a hit with friends and family. After a little more research, I finally got The Dirty Old Goat Soap Company up and running.

feeds.title: Thrifty Homesteader » Goats
feeds.description: Visit the Thrifty Homesteader blog to know about various ailments a goat can have and how to raise your goats the right way. Thrifty Homesteader is about creating a more sustainable life, but what exactly does that mean? It means making choices that will make you healthier, save money, and save the planet.

feeds.title: International Goat Association Blog
feeds.description: We aggregate the best news and most important goat information for you. The International Goat Association promotes goat research and development for the benefit of humankind, to alleviate poverty, to promote prosperity and to improve the quality of life.

feeds.title: Goat Rancher Update
feeds.description: The Goat Rancher Update gives you the most recent goat ranch news as well as other necessary resources and information. Goat Rancher is the nation's leading source of agriculture and food law research and information.

feeds.title: Pack Goats Blog
feeds.description: The blog gives you all the details you need about pack goat gear and other information on goats. My name is Marc Warnke and running Pack Goats is one of the most rewarding things I have done. My family's life has been forever changed by these anointed critters and I feel so blessed to share our lifestyle with you.

feeds.title: Honey Sweetie Acres » Our Goats
feeds.description: We love our Nigerian dwarf dairy goats and love to brag about them. From breeding and caring tips to championship wins, you'll find it here. Honey Sweetie Acres is the home of Registered Nigerian Dwarf Dairy Goats and the luxurious, organic goat milk soap skincare products which they help create.

feeds.title: The Giving Goat
feeds.description: A natural goat care blog focusing on herbals and holistic approaches to goat raising. My methods of natural goat care include, but are not limited to: herbalism, homeopathy, essentials oils/aromatherapy, acupressure/massage/body work, personalized nutrition, holistic illness prevention, and much more!

feeds.title: The Harness Goat Society Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Harness Goat Society's blog to get the latest information on harness goats. We promote the health and wellbeing of working goats, and we're here to help! We aim to act as a course of advice on the optimum type and length of work, suitability of vehicles and packs, and on any other matters pertaining to the health and training of Harness Goats.

feeds.title: Prancing Pony Farm Blog » Dairy Goat
feeds.description: Read about how to care for goats and what is the right kind of goat for you on our blog. Hi, my name is Kim Crawmer and I'm a Navy wife turned farmer! We are a family farm that breeds Mini Nubian and Nigerian Dwarf dairy goats, as well as Maremma Sheepdog Livestock Guardian dogs.

feeds.title: Ridgetop Farm & Garden Blog » Goat
feeds.description: Our goat blog informs you about the goats on our farm and information on their breeding. Ridgetop Farm & Garden is a small family farm that focuses on sustainable living and a fondness for chicken.

feeds.title: Texas Goat Blog
feeds.description: Do you want to know all there is to know about goats? You're in the right place. Welcome to our goat blog. Here you will find information concerning goat care, goat health and illnesses, goat videos, news about Texas goats, goat names, and current goat market reports.

feeds.title: Goat Journal
feeds.description: Do you want to know everything about goats? Read our Backyard Goats journal for more information. Countryside & Small Stock Journal is more than a magazine - it's a network where homesteaders share a wide variety of experiences and ideas about simple, sustainable, country living.

feeds.title: Goatfully Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest and greatest news, insights, and gossip from the goats. Goatfully was founded in the early 2020's by passionate Dutch entrepreneurs. We use goat's milk from our family-run farm to make healthy foods with an unseen mild taste. Goat's milk is easier to digest than cow's milk and more natural than plant-based dairy alternatives.
